about_the_game:
FEATURES

  • Late Night Touge Roads
    Test your ride limits on those tight and twisty mountain roads, find the right opportunity to overtake your rival... or just go on a relaxing night run, it's up to you!

  • HardDrive Physics
    Inspired on the real driving feel, the car moving side to side on corners, being brutally pushed against your seat when using boost... fun 1st, realism 2nd. Cars are super playful on lower speeds, and grippier as the speed increases!

  • 2000s Tuners Customization
    Enjoy the golden age of automobile customization: change bumpers, tailights, hoods, add some neons, vynils... you name it! Here, cars are like a blank canvas waiting for your unique touch! (atm only customization presets available!)

  • Intense Challenges
    Aggressive yet precise Racers will push beyond your limits, NPC logic is tuned to the max! Explore the many available types of events, ranging from sprint, eliminator, circuit, timetrial, nightrun... (and more to come!)

  • Level Based World
    Choose which event to join and jump straight into action! Beat events to unlock more car parts, more events, and even shop types! World areas are still free to explore through the NightRun mode, which you can use it for pratice or just enjoy the scenery.

  • Photomode
    Use the PhotoMode to capture any moment, stop the time, pop out the camera, shoot, you got photo! :D
    Rendering resolution up to 8K when using 720p screen resolution.

  • Optimized Graphics
    Made to run and look good even on potato PCs! (Stable 60FPS at 720p)
    Featuring optimized realtime reflections with near zero performance impact.

  • Crossplatform Cloud Sync
    Specially useful if you have a portable handheld like the SteamDeck. So you can freely switch between devices that use Steam, and everytime you boot the game, everything will stay as you have left it!

NOTE!
For a limited time, both demo and early access versions are identical!!
You can get the paid version (now for a lower price) to help support the project and keep receiving more content after the demo stops updating!

WARNING!
Game under active development, AKA I'll be adding more features, cars and expand the world and update this store page accordingly!
If you want to know more and be the first to know what's next, be sure to follow me on socials (@f11bot).
I'll be posting there snippets of what's being worked on... so, stay tuned! :D

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 7200U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 770, GeForce 940mx (Vulkan Compatible)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p60 with Low Graphics. When in doubt, try the demo out!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel i5 7200U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1, Intel UHD 770
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p60 with Low Graphics. When in doubt, try the demo out!

short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of street racing, go on an adventure on those 2000s summer nights. Take care of your ride, upgrade it, customize it! Unlock and explore cars never seen before, discover new roads, take up new challenges! Or just go on a relaxing night run, it's up to you!
